runtime: Doe C runtime (doe-gpu package, libwebgpu_doe_c / webgpu_doe_c.dll)
comparedWith: webgpu npm package 0.4.0 (Dawn), same machine, same process harness
harness: python3 bench/cli.py run-config --side baseline|comparison, then bench/cli.py compare; 16 timed samples + 1 warmup per run; runs interleaved baseline, comparison, comparison, baseline
metric: operation time p50 (doe-execution-total-ns), lower is better

rows.sourceCommit: 193b8df9f plus the change committed as d4e23d9d3
rows.correctness: final token 1664 and identical readback sha256 on Doe and Dawn in every run

notWins: Apple M3 Metal, single-token decode with resident weights: Doe 25-30% slower (being fixed)
Windows D3D12 Gemma 3 1B 64+64 warm: Doe 6-8% slower; cold measured before the d4e23d9d3 compiler fix: 30% slower
Apple M3 Metal Gemma 270M 64+64 warm: parity to small win, noisy under host load
AMD Vulkan rows: not yet re-measured on the C runtime
limits: Single machine per row. Run receipts stay on the measuring hosts; this file carries no host names or addresses.
